 Job Description
 

  • Responsibilities:
 The Adobe AEM Developer will serve as the AEM SME and will drive design and implementation of the AEM solutions.
 He/she will be responsible for the development, review and deployment of code, workflows.
 The developer will be responsible for setting best practices for AEM and will constantly seek improvements for the AEM implementation. He/she should be able to mentor junior members in the team.
 Qualifications:
 - Strong communication skills
 - Overall 8+ years of relevant experience, 3+ years in Adobe AEM/ CQ5 enterprise content management system
 - Experience in development of components, templates, dialogues, widgets, and OSGI bundles - Experience developing components using Sightly Hands-on experience with Spring, REST, JSON, CSS, HTML, Javascript
 - Experience with Perforce preferred Agile experience strongly preferred
 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

 Direct Staffing Inc
